name: GET /admin/security/secrets-kms-status — api-gateway
description: Operator view of the SECRETS-layer KMS — the provider that wraps the DEKs behind sdk-secrets refs (secret://...), distinct from BYOK tenant keys on /admin/vault/kms-status. Re-resolved on every call from the current environment, so it shows what the env says NOW (the boot log shows what was installed; a disagreement is itself the finding). Returns { success: true, data: { kind, selectedBy, protectedEnvironment, candidates, durable, masterKeyVersion, warning } }. durable is false only for 'mock-local' (in-memory KEKs: every secret written becomes undecryptable after a restart — warning says so). masterKeyVersion is set only for 'local-master' (SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_VERSION, default 1). QA edge case: in a protected environment with nothing configured the resolver throws, and the route still answers 200 with kind null, selectedBy 'unresolved', durable false and the remedy in warning — an unconfigured KMS is a state for the operator to act on, not a 500.

errorCases.when: x-admin-ops-token header is missing, empty, or matches neither the env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN break-glass secret nor an active row in admin.ops_token

testCases.name: Report which secrets KMS is active and whether it is durable
